snippet.title: ᑕIᖇᑕᒪE. - TᖇᗩIᒪEᖇ
snippet.description:
Play ᑕIᖇᑕᒪE. now at Itch.io

ᑕIᖇᑕᒪE. is a game where you must keep a ball within a circle as it gains speed and tries to break free.
The gameplay is intuitive and simple. After each hit on the paddle, the ball speeds up, making it progressively harder to keep it within the circle.
